newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - KLA Instruments raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - KLA Instruments raised.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens raised its rating on shares of KLA Instruments Corp to buy from long-term attractive noting the company's shares have fallen 20 percent since mid-February and now represent "a good buying opportunity."
-- In a statement the company said it expects semiconductor chip makers to continue to invest in yield management tools. KLA makes chip manufacturing equipment.

-- Robertson, Stephens said operating efficiences should start appearing in fiscal 1998 from KLA's proposed merger with Tencor Instruments and KLA's revenue and earnings per share comparisons should turn positive in Q1 fiscal 1998, ending September 1997.
